rows.behaviour: ArrowDown opens the popover and highlights the first option
Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger (E3)
Typeahead jumps to a matching option
Home/End move to the first and last option
Alt+ArrowDown opens without moving the highlight
Typing several characters within the timeout forms one query
